ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
en: (1) I swear by this city [i.e., Makkah] –
(2) And you, [O Muḥammad], are free of restriction in this city –
(3) And [by] the father[1924] and that which was born [of him],
enNotes: [1924]- Said to be Adam (upon him be peace) .

en: (4) We have certainly created man into hardship.

ar: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ
en: (5) Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
tr: Ayaḥsabu al lay yaqdira ʿalayhi aḥad

en: (6) He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."
(7) Does he think that no one has seen him?
(8) Have We not made for him two eyes?
(9) And a tongue and two lips?
(10) And have shown him the two ways?[1925]
(11) But he has not broken through the difficult pass.[1926]
enNotes: [1926]- i.e., the steep incline or obstacle. In other words, he has not spent in the cause of Allāh but only boasts of spending in front of others.

en: (12) And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
(13) It is the freeing of a slave

ar: أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌ فِى يَوْمٍ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍ
en: (14) Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
tr: Aw iṭʿāmun fī yawmin dhī masghabah

en: (15) An orphan of near relationship
(16) Or a needy person in misery

ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
en: (17) And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
tr: Thumma kāna minal-ladhīna āmanū watawāṣaw biṣ-ṣabri watawāṣaw bil-marḥamah

en: (18) Those are the companions of the right.[1927]
enNotes: [1927]- Or "the companions of good fortune," i.e., those who receive their records in their right hands and proceed to Paradise.

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
en: (19) But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.[1928]
enNotes: [1928]- Or "the companions of ill fortune," i.e., those who receive their records in their left hands and proceed to Hell.

en: (20) Over them will be fire closed in.[1929]
enNotes: [1929]- The cover over Hell will be sealed and locked, containing its fire and its inhabitants.
